name: Arthur
source:
Arthur is sweet and romantic. He works hard and likes to daydream about the perfect future with a loving family. Despite his busy schedule, he will always find time to call his lover. He can be a worrywart because he cares too much.

[From [url=https://chanimk.itch.io/mixed-feelings-demo]itch.io[/url]]
